thread:
Jordan M: Follow-up from last week's PMs: action items keep piling. Proposing a mandatory owner + SLA model so things actually ship. quick brainstorm?

Priya N: love this. current "team" ownership is a black hole. mandatory owner + due date is 👍

Ethan L: for SLAs, maybe differentiate by risk and work type. e.g. monitoring/config -> 7 days, infra/code with migrations -> 21 days.

Jordan M: yes. my simple proposal:
- Owner assigned when postmortem published (explicit user)
- Action type tags: monitoring, config, infra, code, docs, security
- SLA baseline: monitoring/config = 7d, infra/code = 21d, security = 3d triage + 21d remediation
- Auto reminders at 48h and 3 days before due date, escalate 48h after overdue

Maya R: +1. also add a short closure checklist that must be attached to the follow-up ticket: what was changed, runbooks updated, metrics to watch.

Priya N: can we add an automatic "recurrence flag" computed from recent incidents? e.g. if same service had 2 incidents in 30 days, mark high priority.

Ethan L: we can. ops-metrics team already exports a per-service incident count. automation can tag and bump priority.

oncall-bot: I can create a follow-up ticket on publish. sample template:
```
Summary: PM follow-up - <INCIDENT_ID>
Owner: <username>
Type: <monitoring|config|infra|code|docs|security>
Priority: <low|med|high|critical>
Due: <iso-date>
ReoccurrenceScore: <0-5>
ClosureChecklist: <link-to-doc>
Postmortem: <link>
```

Jordan M: communications cadence idea:
- T+15m: incident announce to #incidents + relevant squad channels
- T+1h: IC assigned (priority: oncall -> previous oncall -> escalation list)
- T+4h: public status update if still degraded
- T+24h: short triage note and postmortem draft started
- Postmortem published: within 72h (draft)

Priya N: rotation: I propose weekly IC rotation aligned with the oncall calendar but we include a 3-person backup pool to avoid handover gaps. also require a 48h handover doc for active incidents.

Ethan L: Agree on 3-person pool. Also require the oncall owner to list current follow-ups + owners in the incident header before their shift ends. avoids surprises.

Maya R: closure criteria proposal (must be explicit on follow-up ticket):
- Fix deployed and verified for 2x incident window OR mitigation in place + monitoring
- Runbook updated with steps taken
- Short lessons-learned bullets (1-3)
- Postmortem linked and ticket marked resolved

Priya N: can we set a weekly review meeting for overdue follow-ups? 15min to triage top 5 overdue.

Jordan M: yes, weekly "PM follow-up review" slot. dashboard view: incident id, owner, due, status, recurrence score, notes. keep it lightweight.

Ethan L: automation plan: bot creates ticket on publish -> if owner omitted assign to current oncall -> ping owner + manager at 48h -> escalate to eng-sre lead at 48h overdue -> add slack reminder in incident thread.

oncall-bot: Noted: will add escalation steps. Also can tag follow-ups with recent-incident-count for recurrence.

Maya R: next steps: Jordan to draft SLA matrix + closure checklist. Priya to draft IC rotation rules. Ethan to scope automation requirements. I'll schedule a 15-min pilot review next Tuesday.

Jordan M: I'll drop the draft SLA matrix by EOD Wednesday.

Priya N: will draft rotation rules and share in this thread.

Ethan L: will start a short RFC for the bot wiring and Jira issue type.

Maya R: thanks all. let's try this on the next 3 postmortems and iterate. :rocket:
